evidence.evidence_text: We propose PoseStitch-SLT, a novel pre-training scheme that is inspired by linguistic-templates-based sentence generation technique.

With translation comparison on two sign language datasets, How2Sign and iSign, we show that a simple transformer-based encoder-decoder architecture outperforms the prior art when considering template-generated sentence pairs in training.
